summary: The selected blocker tags are charged with exact tagged multiplicity, the lifted parent-child identity preserves mass and the full base-plus-continuous first moment, and the occurrence, complement, and ancestry-parent packets admit the claimed collision-safe source ledger. The occurrence and complement contribution is at most 1/2 pointwise and the ancestry-parent contribution is at most 1/32, giving 17/32. The multipacket theorem applies fiberwise to the complete joint ledger, its stated restrictions are positive submeasures, and the centroid choice in the accepted square theorem yields the collision-safe square-output domination before scaling from gamma_d to 1/e. All mass constants and strict comparisons are correct. The support and base set of the blocker-complement-parent measure are exact, equation (56) makes its residual span equal to the blocker-and-parent centroid residual span for every affine selector, and the dominated-measure capacity bounds and hard-branch rearrangements have the stated constants and scope.
